items.title: Advanced Machine Learning for REE Prospectivity Mapping in Carbonatite-Alkaline Complexes
items.summary: The content discusses the use of advanced machine learning techniques for prospectivity mapping of Rare Earth Elements (REE) in carbonatite-alkaline complexes. It highlights the integration of multi-sensor remote sensing data and machine learning algorithms like Random Forest and XGBoost to enhance exploration targeting and decision-making. The approach emphasizes model explainability and uncertainty quantification to improve stakeholder confidence and risk management.
problems: Discrimination of REE-associated minerals in complex geological settings
Handling high-dimensional, geospatial data
Quantifying prediction uncertainty in mineral exploration
Sensitivity to vegetation cover, cloud contamination, and sensor resolution
techniques: Structural analysis using DEM-derived lineament density maps
outcomes: Rapid and cost-effective screening of large areas for REE potential
Improved model explainability and uncertainty metrics
Enhanced exploration targeting through multi-source data integration

items.title: Advancements in using SAR data for geological mapping
items.summary: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) has revolutionized geological mapping by providing high-resolution, all-weather imaging, overcoming limitations of traditional optical methods. The integration of AI and machine learning enhances SAR's utility, enabling automated image interpretation and real-time geological assessments, crucial for mineral exploration and geoscience applications.
problems: Limitations of optical remote sensing due to cloud cover and darkness
Complex data processing requirements for SAR imagery
High costs for ultra-high-resolution SAR imagery
Limited spectral information compared to hyperspectral sensors
risks: High costs for commercial SAR data
Integration challenges with other data types
outcomes: Improved geological mapping and mineral exploration
Enhanced landslide risk mapping and ground deformation monitoring
Reduced field survey costs and improved safety

items.title: Advances in AI-Powered Bauxite Prospectivity Mapping
items.summary: The content discusses AI-powered bauxite prospectivity mapping, highlighting a novel approach that integrates multispectral and radar satellite imagery to improve exploration efficiency. This method reduces the need for extensive fieldwork by identifying high-potential zones with greater accuracy and speed.
problems: Time-consuming and costly traditional bauxite exploration methods
Challenges in exploring remote or inaccessible regions
outcomes: Identification of high-potential zones with greater accuracy and speed
Significant reduction in initial exploration footprint

items.title: Cobalt in Battery Supply Chains
items.summary: Cobalt is essential for the global battery supply chain, particularly in electric vehicles and renewable energy technologies. Remote sensing technologies like hyperspectral and SAR are crucial for locating cobalt deposits and monitoring mining activities to ensure ESG compliance. The cobalt supply chain faces challenges such as artisanal mining risks and market volatility, with China and the DRC playing significant roles in the market.
problems: Artisanal mining risks
Market volatility
Need for diversified supply sources
ESG compliance
risks: Artisanal mining environmental and social risks
outcomes: China imports 20% and exports 58% of battery materials
Indonesia's cobalt output increased by 86% in 2023
Remote sensing aids in ESG monitoring and artisanal mining detection

items.title: Using LiDAR for Tailing Dam Monitoring
items.summary: LiDAR is crucial for real-time monitoring of tailings dams, providing high-resolution 3D data that surpasses traditional methods. It enables continuous monitoring and enhances safety by integrating with other remote sensing technologies and AI/ML for anomaly detection.
problems: Traditional surveillance methods struggle with early-stage deformation detection.
High upfront costs for LiDAR hardware and data processing.
Complex data management and interpretation requirements.
risks: Limited value when used in isolation

items.title: Remote sensing study for bauxite exploration in the Payas–İslahiye region, SE Turkey
items.summary: The remote sensing study conducted by Scanminers in the Payas–İslahiye region of Southeast Turkey aimed to identify new bauxite potential beyond known mines. The study utilized multi-sensor fusion techniques to produce prospectivity maps and target lists, identifying seven high-potential zones and 183 high-priority target points for future exploration.
problems: Dense vegetation and rugged terrain obscure surface geology
Traditional mapping alone is insufficient for full system visibility
Need for regional-scale visibility to optimize exploration budgets
outcomes: Fusion maps and target lists delivered for planning

items.title: Payas–İslahiye Pilot: Targeting High-Potential Zones
items.summary: The Payas–İslahiye Pilot project utilized the AI-MPM workflow to prioritize exploration targets for bauxite and aluminum in Turkey. The integration of spectral and radar indicators resulted in a ranked shortlist of high-potential zones, supported by prospectivity layers and confidence bands for auditability.
problems: Rapid prioritization of exploration targets
Integration of multi-sensor data for mineral exploration
risks: Need for calibration against known occurrences
outcomes: Confidence bands and rationale layers for auditability
Field planning package for rapid ground truthing

items.title: Regional-Scale Critical Mineral Screening (Conceptual Example)
items.summary: This case study demonstrates Scanminers' regional-scale prospectivity workflow for screening a large area for bauxite and critical minerals using remote sensing and GeoAI. The workflow integrates multi-sensor data and AI-driven analysis to identify and rank high-potential target zones, achieving high predictive accuracy and reducing exploration footprint and costs.
problems: Screening large regions for mineral prospectivity
Ranking targets by prospectivity with explainable reasoning
Validating model predictions against known mineral occurrences
Reducing exploration footprint and costs
dataRequirements: Public stream sediment and soil sample data
